entries.01a85fb9c2801183: TOW CO.,LTD. is an event and promotion planning and production company with strength in the experience domain.
entries.0537492b346f8f92: In the advertising and marketing market, the importance of integrated promotions that combine real and digital is increasing, and demand for experiential value remains firm. The company's sales are centered on indirect sales through advertising agencies, and Hakuhodo Inc., its largest sales destination, accounts for 25.4% of total sales.
entries.0a57be4177d32803: Its main sales destinations are advertising agencies, and Hakuhodo Inc. is its largest sales destination. In addition to indirect sales through advertising agencies, it is also expanding direct sales to companies and government bodies.
entries.12d9d0ab100a2a4f: It receives orders for event and promotion work from advertising agencies and companies, provides a consistent service from analysis and research through strategy planning, proposals, implementation and production, to effect verification, and earns production fees.
entries.225e9d18958f5aed: Its strategic axes are both expanding real events, which are the core of its revenue, and extending its business domain from promotion into the real entertainment domain. While real events are growing, hybrid events and integrated promotions are shrinking, and the company is responding to changes in its category mix while also expanding into new domains through the acquisition of consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.240fedd239a35cbe: Under its purpose, 'Creating new experiences for a new era,' it formulated a mid-term business growth vision in February 2026 and set out as its target image an 'experience partner that spans promotion and real entertainment.' As its growth strategy, it is pursuing business expansion along two axes, 'expansion of clients' and 'expansion of domains,' and positions the experience entertainment market (real entertainment) as a growth area. It has adopted the basic AI policy 'AI for Experience Partner' and is also incorporating AI across its entire business processes.

entries.6cb202bbf69dca02: Its features are a producer structure that handles everything from planning through implementation, production and effect verification, and an in-house group production structure through a group of consolidated subsidiaries responsible for production, operation and direction, video production and digital content. It has built a track record in receiving large ceremony and exposition projects, and continuing transactions with advertising agencies form the basis for its orders.
